modify.note: Update the producer service to depend on WebhookTasker instead of InternalTasker and pass its existing payloads through `deliverWebhook`. Preserve the tasker framework's established dispatch and error behavior so the producer does not invent a separate fallback policy or accidentally deliver a webhook twice.

add_nodes.label: Webhook tasker
add_nodes.summary: WebhookTasker choosing a synchronous or Trigger.dev implementation of IWebhookTasker by environment.
add_nodes.note: New WebhookTasker that routes webhook delivery using the same environment-based dispatch pattern as the existing taskers. Define the shared `IWebhookTasker` contract around the existing WebhookTaskPayload and `{ taskId }` result, then supply synchronous and Trigger.dev implementations to the Tasker base class. Use `ENABLE_ASYNC_TASKER` through that common mechanism so production can enqueue work while an environment without async task processing can complete delivery immediately. WebhookSyncTasker returns an identifier through the same result shape. WebhookTriggerTasker dynamically loads and triggers the webhook job and returns the queued task's identifier. The Trigger.dev job validates the same payload schema; wire its job configuration and schema re-export. Keep payload construction and actual delivery semantics shared across both modes. Add the corresponding DI tokens and modules using the project's binding pattern.

add_edges.label: runs WebhookTaskConsumer
add_edges.note: WebhookSyncTasker calls the injected WebhookTaskConsumer directly and awaits its work; the Trigger.dev job resolves the consumer through the existing dependency-injection container and executes the same delivery operation.
